Name: Pumpkin Smacker
Design brief: Halloween baseball bat with a long segmented pumpkin-orange rounded barrel, a simple friendly jack-o-lantern face inset on its side, green collar with two small attached leaves, dark purple grip and orange knob. Keep a recognisable elongated bat, not a pumpkin on a stick.

Name: Lucky Clover
Design brief: Festive emerald-green baseball bat with an elongated rounded barrel, one large raised gold four-leaf-clover inlay, cream collar rings, deep green grip and gold knob. One small gold buckle decoration around the lower barrel. No hat, text or detached coins.

Name: Festival Dragon
Design brief: Lunar New Year-themed baseball bat with a long lacquer-red rounded barrel, broad raised gold cloud-scroll bands, a small rounded friendly dragon-head cap blended into the blunt tip, navy seams and cream grip with red end knob. Model-friendly chunky dragon muzzle, two short horns, no whisker filaments or loose ribbons, no text.

Name: Peppermint Slugger
Design brief: Christmas baseball bat with a long rounded candy-cane red-and-ivory spiral barrel, a dark green chunky collar with two attached holly leaves and three red round berries, navy grip and red knob. Straight baseball-bat profile rather than a hooked candy cane, no writing.

Name: Egg Hunt
Design brief: Easter baseball bat with a long pastel-lavender rounded barrel, broad mint and pale-yellow egg-pattern bands, a small raised carrot-shaped orange inlay, cream collar, soft pink grip and mint knob. No detached eggs or rabbit characters, clear bat proportions.

Name: Birthday Wish
Design brief: A birthday cake-and-candles BASEBALL BAT: long cream-frosted rounded bat barrel with broad attached pink frosting drips and chunky cyan sprinkle inlays; at the blunt upper end three short thick pastel candles sit attached in a neat cluster, each with a tiny solid yellow teardrop flame. Lavender collar, pink wrapped grip and gold knob. The underlying silhouette must remain a full baseball bat, not a cake hammer. No text, logos, numbers or loose confetti.
